# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a mobile app for general wellness and self-reflection. It includes short CBT-inspired cards, guided tools, a structured journal, and mood, stress, and energy check-ins. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.
